The owner ruling of 2026-08-24 (“a spell token is a token…”), the owner ruling of 2026-08-24 (“tokens are NOT cards, and trashing…”), the owner ruling of 2026-09-28 (“Spell tokens ARE played: a token…”) and the owner ruling of 2026-09-28 (“Tokens are NOT trashed: the owner…”) stand, Void Mandible's "nontoken" is shorthand, and the rules that state them stand (108.2a no longer calls it an open question).

question.ask: In battle, may a Virus be augmented onto a spell token standing in play (not one being cast)?

readings.label: A
readings.text: Yes: a spell token is a spell, and a Virus may "hit enemy spells" in battle (Caleb), so a token in play is a legal battle host.
readings.table: A Virus, or a Rook-enabled augment, can give a Fireball token standing on the board Deadly or Powerful mid-battle; the engine needs the second path the owner ruling of 2026-08-23 (“[…] missing half: a SPELL TOKEN may…”) describes.

question.recommend: A, the permissive reading. The owner ruling of 2026-08-23 (“[…] missing half: a SPELL TOKEN may…”) already reads {Virus} as buying the timing, not the host.
